## Documented role

[Van der Klift and Norman Kunc, “Hell-Bent on Helping” (1994)](../sources/1994-van-der-klift-hell-bent.qmd) is a published chapter on help and inclusive education. The inspected Broadreach republication does **not** name ECPM, CSIL, BC Rehab, Greater Vancouver Home Support Society, or Vancouver Health Department.

No inspected public source in this catalogue identifies her as author of a 1994 ECPM training manual. The 1990 ECPM manual’s Roeher entry names corporate authors only.

This archive does **not** infer ECPM or CSIL design-group membership.

## Attributed recollection / later organizational wording

None recorded from an inspected public source. The commissioning issue and later research brief *name* her in connection with a possible 1994 ECPM training revision. That is a wanted-source hypothesis, not a cited recollection. See the [wanted ECPM manuals record](../sources/wanted-ecpm-manuals.qmd) and the [ECPM chapter](../history/ecpm.qmd).

## Unresolved

- Whether a 1994 ECPM training manual exists and, if so, whether she is named on it.
- Whether “1994 ECPM manual” in later notes is a conflicting citation of the 1990 Roeher-cited manual, a distinct edition, or a confusion with this 1994 chapter.
- Experiment 001 classified that identity question as **INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE**.

This page does not invite unsolicited contact. Any later verification belongs with [Issue #7](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/csil-history/issues/7).
